name: Sonoya Mizuno
bio: Sonoya Mizuno (born 1 July 1986) is a British actress. She is best known for her roles in the Netflix series Maniac (2018), the HBO series House of the Dragon (2022–), FX miniseries Devs (2020) and the film Crazy Rich Asians (2018).

credits.title: Elden Ring
credits.overview: In a place known as the Lands Between, the powerful Elden Ring has been shattered with its shards divided amongst corrupted demigods.

credits.title: Eternal Return
credits.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming
